purpose: Constructed labeled pilot, not product-wide accuracy

protocol.description: Controlled retrieval pilot constructed from DAVIS real footage and instance masks. Research-only media; no general accuracy or cross-camera identity claim.

limitations: Query frames 0,4,8 are excluded with the first 12 frames; nearby frames still share scene context.
Three query frames of an instance are correlated; report both query and distinct source counts.
Development/test assignment is project-specific and differs from original DAVIS train/val.
Negative sources are excluded from gallery. Selected non-human objects inspected before scoring; no claim about unannotated identities across unrelated footage.
Short clips concatenated at 24 fps stress shot changes; sampling findings do not estimate rates in the user's long gameplay video.
Grid is an experiment, not a deployed detector. Raw scores across configurations need separate calibration.
All thresholds and configuration selection use dev only. Test comparisons are retained including failures.
Model pretraining overlap with public DAVIS is unknown. This is not an unseen-data or commercial-use certification.

measurement.peak_match: same video, start <= peak < end; no tolerance
measurement.temporal_match: same video and interval IoU >= 0.5; one-to-one matching for event recall
measurement.false_accept: absent query with at least one result above threshold
measurement.calibration: dev only: absent FAR <= 0.05, maximize correct accepted positive top1; ties minimize wrong accepts, then maximize threshold
measurement.configuration_selection: dev calibrated correct-top1 F1; tie prefers fewer indexed vectors
measurement.negative_budget_resolution: 18 absent dev queries per kind => 0 allowed false accepts at 5% budget
measurement.independence: three frames per object; objects within one source share context; no independent-query confidence interval
measurement.identity_scope: source/time retrieval against instance-presence masks, not instance identity localization within a frame
measurement.sampling: subsample a real 2 fps desktop index on the same decoded frame lattice; coarser decoder throughput is not measured

run.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU
